module_directory_task_method.name: module_directory_proof_pass
module_directory_task_method.description: Use the irqchip-style workflow for future trimming: choose one specific module directory, recursively inventory it, classify every subdirectory/file against the fixed x86_64+arm64 QEMU Minix storage contract, accumulate all confirmed-safe whole-file/whole-directory deletions in that same module task, then validate and commit once.
module_directory_task_method.task_unit: one specific module directory and its recursive children, such as drivers/scsi, drivers/acpi, scripts, tools, kernel/trace, or lib/zstd
per_task_steps: Record current source status excluding .codex-qemu-kernels and stop on dirty source conflicts.

Inventory the selected module directory recursively: files, subdirectories, Kconfig symbols, Makefile objects, fixed .config state, generated .cmd source/object dependencies, include/reference edges, and current build artifacts for x86_64 and arm64.
Classify each child as keep, delete_candidate, already_removed, or defer, with a short reason tied to the fixed validation contract.
Do not delete after the first confirmed file. Finish the full module-directory pass first, then delete the whole confirmed-safe bucket from that module in one change set.
Prefer whole subdirectory deletion, then whole-file deletion. Do not do file-internal trimming unless it is strictly mechanical fallout from deleting a file/directory.
Remove stale Kconfig/Makefile/defconfig references only as mechanical fallout for the same module task.
Verify no empty source directories remain for the affected module task.
Run git diff --check before commit and the fixed storage validation command before accepting the change.
Create one source commit for the module task if validation passes; do not commit .codex-qemu-kernels.
Update state.json and add a local review note with evidence, validation logs, and the next module-directory task.
module_directory_task_method.commit_granularity: one commit per completed module-directory proof pass when deletions are found; if a directory pass finds nothing safe to delete, update state/review only and move to the next directory without a source commit.
module_directory_task_method.do_not_split_rule: Within one selected module directory, continue analyzing sibling files/subdirectories before committing; bundle all confirmed-safe deletions from that same module task into one commit.
module_directory_task_method.plain_rule_zh: 和刚才 drivers/irqchip 的方式一样：先完整梳理当前选定模块目录里需要删除的文件/子目录，形成可删集合；确认后统一删除；验证通过后只做一个源码 commit。
commit_flow_zh: 先梳理：递归审视当前模块目录，确认哪些文件/子目录对固定 x86_64+arm64 QEMU Minix 存储目标无用。
再删除：同一个模块目录内确认可删的内容一次性删除，并清理对应 Kconfig/Makefile/defconfig 死引用。
一个 commit：固定合约验证通过后，该模块目录任务只形成一个源码 commit；不要按单个文件或单个子模块拆多个 commit。
